item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Neutral (+0.06)] NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) & Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): Nvidia Might Ship AI Chips With Less Memory. AMD Says It’s Not Worried
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Neutral (+0.06)
NVIDIA is reportedly considering shipping its next-generation Rubin Ultra GPU with less high-bandwidth memory than initially promised, potentially as low as 192GB to 256GB, due to a severe industry-wide memory shortage. Meanwhile, its rival Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is proceeding with its Helios AI system, claiming to have secured sufficient memory through strong supplier relationships. This situation raises questions about Nvidia's supply chain management and AMD's increasing competitiveness in the AI chip market.

item.description:

The article highlights a potential conflict with Apple's privacy-centric reputation, as users give a powerful AI chatbot free rein over their communications and data.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.31)] Walmart will let customers use Apple Pay after holding out for more than a decade. Why it finally caved
item.description:
